person.name: Đoàn Quốc Huy
person.title: Fullstack Developer
person.summary: Fullstack developer building web apps with React, Next.js, and Supabase. Applies A* pathfinding, BLE positioning, and 3D visualization to real-world problems.

projects.name: Employee Management
projects.summary: Web app replacing paper shift rosters and Excel payroll sheets for small F&B outlets. Handles shift registration, weekly scheduling, and hourly pay calculation.

highlights.text: Enforce multi-layer security: route proxy + server-side layout guard (requireAuth/requireAdmin) + RLS on Postgres; migrate policies from anon to authenticated; verify anon INSERT returns 401 and anon SELECT returns empty array
Implement role-based access via app_metadata.role; run role-change API server-side with Service Role Key only
Version the database with SQL migrations covering salary/schedule expansion, account linking, shift registration, notifications, and payroll confirmation
Cover business logic with unit tests: shift-hour calculation by role, monthly totals, money formatting, and registration-to-approval-to-payroll flow
Apply CSS token design system; maintain text contrast at WCAG AA level; set touch targets to minimum 44px; support responsive layouts at 375/768/1024/1440px with no horizontal scroll

projects.name: Hospital Indoor Navigation
projects.role: Solo — design, development, data processing, testing
projects.summary: Prototype web app for navigating a multi-floor general hospital: 3D map, A* multi-floor routing, BLE beacon positioning, step-by-step voice guidance, and wheelchair path mode.

highlights.text: Render a three-floor 3D map (Three.js) with floor switching, rotate/zoom, and room color-coding by type
Implement A* multi-floor routing with elevator/stair transitions; wheelchair mode excludes stairs from the path
Bridge BLE beacon signals via Python (bleak) + WebSocket relay with pairing code to operate outside secure context on LAN
Fall back to 2D SVG map when WebGL is unavailable (?force2d=1); include kiosk mode with enlarged text and touch targets
Build admin panel for technicians to view active beacons, assign positions on the 3D map, and record RSSI calibration data
Build Python pipeline (OpenCV, trimesh) converting floor-plan images to 3D GLB models
Deliver step-by-step voice guidance with off-route detection and signal-loss alerts

metrics.label: Beacon calibration + iBeacon decode tests (Python) passed

projects.name: Hospital Quality Survey
projects.summary: Patient satisfaction kiosk and quality management portal built for a Grade-I hospital. Survey flow covers department selection, criteria rating, and NPS; admin dashboard tracks KPIs, charts, and complaints.

highlights.text: Resolve department-code mismatches with a multi-step resolveDepartment function (exact → prefix → name → static map); verify correctness with a custom test script without altering DB data
Enforce two-layer security at server and DB level, not only in UI; apply migration for secure feedback table and status-history tracking
Design for public kiosk use: large touch targets, custom TouchNumpad, KioskIdleTimer auto-reset, and countdown screen after submission
Configure survey forms in the database; maintain surveyFallback so the kiosk works when the API is unavailable
Write idempotent SQL migrations; export complaint data as CSV with UTF-8 BOM for correct Vietnamese character display in Excel

metrics.label: Departments listed in kiosk info modal
